title: Spyglass: Now Generally Available
summary: Unlock powerful new insights with Spyglass, which has officially moved beyond its beta phase and is now fully available to all users.

title: Complete Control Over Your Files

summary: Experience a new level of productivity with our enhanced checkboxes, now boasting improved clickability, modern design, and effortless drag-and-drop functionality.

summary: We've refined our editor to provide a smoother, more intuitive real-time collaboration experience, making teamwork effortless and efficient.

title: Dazzling New Themes & Refreshed Classics
summary: Get ready for a refreshed visual experience as we introduce exciting new themes and perfect our existing ones for unmatched clarity and style.

summary: Explore your entire knowledge base like never before, easily filtering by tags and time, and seeing connections with shared items and friends for a truly dynamic and insightful experience.

summary: Effortlessly find and organize your information using powerful new filters and the ability to save personalized collections for quick, future access.

title: Dynamic Note Layouts
summary: Unlock new levels of productivity with dynamic content displays that intuitively organize your notes and make interacting with linked information more engaging.

title: Unleash Noeko: Self-Hosting Freedom and Premium Capabilities

title: Perfectly Timed Greetings
